summary: Owned-set rollouts that change an agent's harness start a fresh native session on the replacement provider instead of trying to resume the previous provider's conversation.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire changes. Cross-provider rollouts verify the replacement provider's own incarnation-bound session. Same-provider rollouts retain exact native-session and login-account continuity checks.

downtime.detail: Rollouts retain the existing drain and fenced-stop sequence.

recovery.detail: The predecessor session snapshot remains available as history; it is not supplied to a different provider.
